headline: Fed Chair Warsh warns *inflation* elevated despite strong jobs
quote: Americans of course are still dealing with inflation that has been running
title: Fed Chair Warsh Addresses High Inflation and Strong Job Market
caption: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh pointed to historic strength in labor market metrics, noting low unemployment claims. However, he emphasized that inflation has remained above the Fed's two percent target for nearly six years.
comment: Are higher everyday prices still impacting your household expenses?
